description: Header file defining the hdr_histogram structure and associated functions for histogram operations, including initialization, recording values, statistical queries, and iteration.

classes.name: hdr_histogram
classes.description: Structure representing a histogram with statistical data and configuration parameters.

classes.name: hdr_iter
classes.description: Generic iterator structure for traversing histogram data.

classes.name: hdr_histogram_bucket_config
classes.description: Configuration structure for histogram bucket sizing.

methods.name: hdr_iter_linear_set_value_units_per_bucket
methods.description: Updates linear iterator's value units per bucket.

methods.name: hdr_iter_next
methods.description: Advances iterator to next value, returns false if no more data.

methods.name: hdr_percentiles_print
methods.description: Prints histogram percentiles to a stream in specified format.

methods.name: hdr_calculate_bucket_config
methods.description: Calculates bucket configuration based on histogram parameters.

methods.name: hdr_init_preallocated
methods.description: Initializes histogram with preallocated memory based on config.

methods.name: hdr_size_of_equivalent_value_range
methods.description: Returns size of value range equivalent to a given value.

methods.name: hdr_next_non_equivalent_value
methods.description: Returns next value outside the current value's equivalence range.

methods.name: hdr_median_equivalent_value
methods.description: Returns median value within the equivalence range of a given value.

methods.name: hdr_reset_internal_counters
methods.description: Resets internal counters after manual data import.
